name: .355 (9mm) Cal-137gr Jack Hammer®
note: Recommended use: Big Game Hunting / Personal Defense. The product page also says: "This pure copper Jack Hammer™ pistol bullet will give outstanding terminal performance and deep penetration for your 9mm handgun. With 100% weight retention and the cupped nose the Jack Hammer™ will give great straight line deep penetration with outstanding soft tissue damage. With reliable feeding and excellent terminal performance the Jack Hammer™ will make the 9mm handgun a formidable weapon."
